description:
With a lightweight, powerful 250W battery delivering 65 Nm of torque, the ePro is the ideal bike for the steepest and longest rides.

As with all Mercian bikes, the frame is tailor-made to the rider's dimensions. Built in Derby using the finest Reynolds lightweight steel tubing, the frame is designed with a specific larger, butted Reynolds downtube, large enough to accommodate the 250Wh battery. The downtube is custom shaped and fillet brazed into the frame, securely, safely and discreetly carrying the extra power. The internal battery is easily charged via the charging port, reaching 80% in less than 2 hours and full charge in 3.5 hours.

Fitted with a 250W Mahle hub motor, the rear wheel slots into specific Reynolds dropouts (housing the Mahle drive connector unit and motion sensor) and is secured with a 12mm thru axle. The Speed sensor ensures the bike complies with regulations, effortlessly accelerating you up to 25km/h. Battery levels are clearly displayed, at a glance, via the LED display of the top tube mounted iWoc controller which is also used to easily switch through the 3 customisable levels of assistance. Torque and cadence sensing in the bottom bracket lets the system read rider input precisely, and adaptive control matches motor support to your effort and conditions, delivering a responsive, natural ride feel.

With the Mahle X20 battery providing you with approx. 100km of assistance, all-day rides have become a comfortable reality.

Range & weight: 100kms, 15.8kg. Ranges are quoted by battery manufacturer (Mahle) based off rider with an average height & weight, cycling a combination of flat and hilly terrain.

components.description: torque and cadence sensors in the bottom bracket, speed sensor at the hub
